aboutPage.title: About Tech Bridge Academy
aboutPage.intro: Tech Bridge Academy is the digital platform of the TECH BRIDGE VET Erasmus+ project — a transnational initiative connecting VET schools, technical colleges, and manufacturing SMEs across Europe to reduce skills mismatch in the mechanical engineering sector.
aboutPage.challenge1: The mechanical engineering and manufacturing sector across Europe faces a growing skills mismatch: companies cannot find graduates with the right technical and digital competencies, while VET schools struggle to keep curricula aligned with rapidly evolving industry needs.
aboutPage.challenge2: Traditional dialogue between schools and companies is fragmented, informal, and dependent on individual relationships. There is no structured, scalable mechanism to continuously connect what companies need with what schools teach.
aboutPage.challenge3: TECH BRIDGE VET addresses this gap by creating a permanent digital infrastructure for two-way, structured collaboration — with AI-assisted matching, curriculum co-design tools, and a shared repository of proven practices.
aboutPage.obj1: Reduce skills mismatch in the mechanical engineering and manufacturing sector
aboutPage.obj2: Create a sustainable digital infrastructure for structured school-enterprise dialogue
aboutPage.obj3: Develop and validate an AI-assisted matching system for VET schools and SMEs
aboutPage.obj4: Produce a European repository of good practices in skills match initiatives
aboutPage.obj5: Support curriculum co-design processes between educational institutions and industry
aboutPage.obj6: Generate skills foresight data to inform VET curriculum planning
aboutPage.obj7: Train teachers and company HR in effective school-enterprise collaboration
aboutPage.wpSubtitle: The project is structured in five work packages, each addressing a specific set of deliverables

WP1.title: Project Management & Quality Assurance
WP1.desc: Coordination of all project activities, financial management, quality monitoring, and risk mitigation across the consortium.

WP2.title: Needs Analysis & Ecosystem Mapping
WP2.desc: In-depth analysis of skills mismatch in the mechanical engineering sector across partner countries, mapping of existing school-enterprise dialogue mechanisms.

WP3.title: Digital Platform Development
WP3.desc: Design and development of the Tech Bridge Academy platform — the operational core of this project, enabling all digital collaboration services.

WP4.title: Pilot Testing & Validation
WP4.desc: Structured piloting of platform services with real schools and companies in all partner countries, with evaluation and iteration.

WP5.title: Dissemination & Exploitation
WP5.desc: Dissemination of project results across European VET networks, policy recommendations, and sustainability plan for the platform beyond the project period.

p2.role: WP2 needs analysis, WP4 piloting in Northern Italy, repository contribution

p3.description: Research partner contributing expertise in skills foresight, competency mapping, and VET quality assurance.
